ManaTalk: Why Arena Net can care less about GW2 World vs World, and future expectations.

WvW was such a great idea in theory but always ran into the same problem : numbers always win.

Sure there's plenty of videos of a smaller, extremely coordinated group taking out a group twice their size. But what you don't see is the majority side then regrouping and bringing 3x the number of people, which even the best coordination couldn't do much about.

I know the whole point of WvWvW was huge player battles, but it still seems like they should have put some kind of soft limiter on it - maybe only allowing XX number of people in a particular area, or some kind of debuff on particularly large groups (-10%HP when there's more than 100 allies nearby, or whatever) in the interest of balancing things.

It would also force smaller, roaming groups that would encourage more spread-out, roaming skirmishes rather than the huge zerg vs zerg that you often see at work. maybe make SMC an exception so you can keep the enormous fights at least for the largest objective.
